title: Video Games: Epic Adventures
description: Test your knowledge about the coolest video games and gaming secrets!

questions.q: In Minecraft, what do you need to make a Nether Portal?
questions.hint: It's a very dark, hard block that you need a diamond pickaxe to mine!

questions.q: What's the name of Mario's dinosaur companion?
questions.hint: He's green, friendly, and Mario can ride on his back!

questions.q: In Fortnite, what happens when the storm closes in?
questions.hint: If you're caught outside the safe zone, your health starts going down!

questions.q: Which Pokémon is known as the Electric Mouse Pokémon?
questions.hint: He's yellow, says his own name, and is Ash's best friend!

questions.q: What color is Sonic the Hedgehog?
questions.hint: He's the same color as the sky on a clear day!
